title: JumpPadPlugin
description: a best jumppad plugin for minecraft servers
body:
🚀 JumpPadPlugin – The Ultimate Launcher! 🎮
JumpPadPlugin is a super cool, lightweight jump pad plugin for Paper 1.20.1 that makes you fly like a pro! 💨

✨ What does it do?
Directional Launch 🧭 – You don’t just go up; you go forward AND upward in the exact direction you’re looking! Perfect for parkour, lobbies, or just showing off! 😎

Firework Sound 🎆 – Hear that epic "BOOM" launch sound (just like a firework rocket) every time you jump! Toggle it on/off per pad.

Particle Trails ✨ – A jet-style particle trail appears behind you while flying! You can:

Turn it ON/OFF ⚡

Change the color using names like RED 🔴, AQUA 💠, or even hex codes like #FF00AA 🌈

Simple Setup 🖱️ – No typing coordinates! Just do /jumppad set <name> and right-click any block to set the pad location. Easy peasy!

Adjustable Power 💪 – Change the launch speed with /jumppad velocity <name> <number>. Want a gentle hop? Use 1.5 – want to reach the sky? Use 5.0! 🚀

Auto-Save 💾 – All your pads and settings are saved in jumpads.yml, so they survive restarts. No data loss! 😉

📋 Commands (with permission support)
Command	What it does
/jumppad create <name>	🆕 Create a new pad
/jumppad set <name>	🎯 Right-click a block to set location
/jumppad particle <name> <on/off>	💫 Toggle particles
/jumppad particlecolor <name> <color>	🎨 Change particle color
/jumppad sound <name> <on/off>	🔊 Toggle launch sound
/jumppad velocity <name> <number>	📈 Set launch power
🛡️ Permissions
jumppad.* – All powers (admin) 👑

jumppad.create – Create pads 🛠️

jumppad.set – Set locations 📍

jumppad.particle – Toggle particles ✨

jumppad.particlecolor – Change colors 🖌️

jumppad.sound – Toggle sounds 🔊

jumppad.velocity – Change speed 🏎️

🔧 How to Install?
Drop the .jar into your /plugins folder 📁

Restart your server 🔄

Create a pad: /jumppad create MyPad 🆕

Set its location: /jumppad set MyPad then right-click a block 🖱️

Stand on it and fly away! 🕊️💨

🎯 Why use JumpPadPlugin?
Lightweight & fast – no lag ⚡

Fully customizable – colors, sounds, power, particles 🎛️

Professional code – stable and well-built 🏗️

Fun for everyone – players love it! ❤️

Get ready to launch! 🚀🔥
Download now and add some excitement to your server! 🎮✨
